title: Demand-wrap guard bounds only one multiplicand: packet_bandwidth has no upper bound at catalog load
detail: The new bound closes the u32 wrap for the demand factor only. packet_bandwidth >= 2^32/4096 = 1,048,576 still silently wraps the product, corrupting the serialization term the comment claims can never wrap.
recommended_fix: Validate the product jointly at load: bound packet_bandwidth (e.g. <= 1,048,575) or fail-fast when max_class_demand x packet_bandwidth would exceed u32 max.
